hook: A WOODCUTTER|WHO COULDN'T READ|AWAKENED IN A MOMENT

voices.name: l00
voices.text: A woodcutter <#0.2#> who couldn't read. Huineng.
voices.caption: A woodcutter who couldn't read. Huineng.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Selling firewood in the market, <#0.2#> he heard one line of the Diamond Sutra.
voices.caption: Selling firewood in the market, he heard one line of the Diamond Sutra.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: In that moment, <#0.3#> it's said, he awakened.
voices.caption: In that moment, it's said, he awakened.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Awakening once said to take countless lives <#0.2#> is much faster now.
voices.caption: Awakening once said to take countless lives is much faster now.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: You can leap forward <#0.2#> in this life too.
voices.caption: You can leap forward in this life too.
